data.title: 双叶理央 · 物理实验室的白色誓约
data.description: 【物理实验室改造礼堂·午后】理央穿着带银灰腰带的简洁婚纱坐在实验台旁，黑框眼镜与头纱被她分开放好；她用小量筒做花瓶，把蓝色小花插入其中，抬眼时理性神情被温柔取代。
data.location: science lab converted into a quiet ceremony room
data.action: 实验台旁用量筒插花，精准调整花枝后露出意外温柔的笑
data.lighting: cool daylight mixed with warm task lamps
data.promptProse: At the lab table, Rio Futaba precisely adjusts blue flowers in a graduated beaker before looking toward the viewer with unexpected tenderness through black-rimmed glasses. Her white bridal dress has a silver-grey sash and simple veil. The vertical medium-full view includes the arrangement against orderly laboratory surfaces. Cool daylight defines the dress, while warm task lamps glint on the beaker and cast flower shadows onto the tabletop.
